en.heading: Research Interests
en.intro: Two threads, both first-author: how language models are measured, and how they behave on financial text. I prefer claims that can be falsified before a GPU is switched on, and artifacts that let someone else re-run the check.

items.title: Evaluation Methodology & Benchmarks
items.body: Benchmark design, scoring protocols, and the failure modes of automatic scorers — including a pre-registered audit showing first-token scoring is undefined for many Chinese models, confirmed 64/64 against real runs.

items.title: Model Reliability
items.body: Context-faithfulness versus parametric memory, hallucination measurement, judge reliability, and agent trajectory attribution — measuring when a model stops being grounded in what it was given.

items.title: Financial NLP & Risk
items.body: Regulatory disclosure text (10-K/10-Q/8-K, XBRL) as a predictive signal, and distribution-free risk control — including an honest null result on whether disclosure text beats price baselines for volatility.

items.title: Reproducible Practice
items.body: Pre-registration, frozen configs, pinned model revisions, leakage audits, and citable artifacts. Roughly forty public repositories of competition and experiment records.

zh.heading: 研究方向
zh.intro: 两条主线，均为第一作者：语言模型该如何被度量，以及它们在金融文本上的表现。我偏好那些在开 GPU 之前就能被证伪的主张，以及能让别人复跑一遍的工件。

items.title: 评测方法与基准
items.body: 基准设计、打分协议，以及自动打分器的失效模式——包括一项预注册审计：首 token 打分法在许多中文模型上是未定义的，并在真实运行中 64/64 全部验证。

items.title: 模型可靠性
items.body: 上下文忠实性与参数记忆的分离、幻觉度量、judge 可靠性、Agent 轨迹归因——度量模型何时不再忠实于给它的材料。

items.title: 金融 NLP 与风险
items.body: 把监管披露文本（10-K/10-Q/8-K、XBRL）作为预测信号，以及分布无关的风险控制——包括一个诚实的零结果：披露文本并未打赢价格基线。

items.title: 可复现实践
items.body: 预注册、冻结配置、锁定模型版本、泄漏审计、可引用工件。约四十个公开的竞赛与实验记录仓库。
